rule: a PI is a faculty member of a computing department (Princeton CS; CMU's seven SCS departments; MIT EECS, CS+AI side; EPFL IC; Berkeley EECS, CS division) with stated PhD advising in 2016-2026 or a lab they head. Centres, initiatives and multi-PI groups are not labs. EPFL MERs count when they head their own lab or are stated PhD thesis directors.
captures: hierarchy/missing-pi-captures.sqlite (fetched or copied pages; quotes are exact substrings of the stored text, whitespace collapsed)

decisions.name: Jaswinder Pal Singh
decisions.summary: A CS professor throughout 2016-2026, but with no stated PhD advising in the window and no lab he heads. Not in pis.json because tools/princeton_census.py takes the 91 own-lab PIs of the lab-by-lab records plus faculty with a named PhD adviser field in 2016-2026 (ADDED), and he is in neither: his last PhD alumnus on the CS roster graduated in 2014 (Adrian Soviani); no graduate-student roster row 2016-2026 names him adviser; DataSpace has no 2016-2026 dissertation he advised (his 15 CS theses 2016-2023 are senior theses). His one leadership role is co-director of DeCenter, a centre that Matt Weinberg directs, which is a collective, not his lab. A 2026 postdoc (Aviv Yaish) is co-hosted with Weinberg; postdoc hosting is not PhD advising.
